display.purpose: The landing hero headline; the download h1 at a smaller clamp.

title.purpose: Sub-headings such as the download page's Development build.

lead.purpose: The muted paragraph under a heading, 52-62ch.

numeral.purpose: Benchmark times and fact figures, tabular.

mono.purpose: Script lines, server output, code, hashes; ligatures off.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata: staff column heads, Same / N× faster marks, licence line. Never an eyebrow.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat; Starlight's --sl-shadow-sm/md/lg are set to none. Depth is tone and hairlines.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve for every transition and animation.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and focus transitions: link underline, pill background and border, staff row tint, arrow nudge.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Differential staff rows enter once, top to bottom.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Benchmark bars draw out from the staff.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations and delays 0s
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce shows everything at its end state.

extensions.csp: Stylesheets are emitted as files (inlineStylesheets: never, assetsInlineLimit: 0); authored code uses no inline <style> or style attributes; inline scripts run only by SHA-256 hash (public/_headers, scripts/headers.mjs); fonts self-hosted, font-src 'self'. style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' only for the style attributes Starlight writes.

components.description: Three steps on one hairline, numbered by a magenta JetBrains Mono counter.

1. Take out Skript.jar. Leave its folder where it is.
  2. Put in NeoSkript.jar. Paper or Folia.

narrative.overview:
neoskript.dev is NeoSkript's own brand on night, laid out with xenastudios.co's grammar: hairlines, pills, one column of ideas, no cards. Every colour, logo and scene comes from xena-studios/brand (tokens/neoskript.*, synced into src/brand/ by pnpm brand:sync); the site composes them with exact type, hairline rules and space. Xena frames the product with the planet horizon and the XENA endorsement in the footer, and nothing else.

The signature is the staff: the same script (or the same measured job) runs down a raised centre column between two magenta rails, with Skript's result mirrored on its left and NeoSkript's on its right, one grid row per line so the two sides always line up. The landing page leads with a performance staff whose bars share one scale, so a bar's length is the time it took, then a differential staff that prints what each server output for the same probe. The rest of the site is hairline rows, plain claims and links to source.

Two surfaces share one palette. The custom pages (landing, download) are dark only (color-scheme: dark) and styled by src/styles/site.css. The guides are Starlight, mapped onto the same tokens in src/styles/theme.css, with a light theme in ink and magenta-daylight.
keyCharacteristics: Neo Magenta on near-black, aubergine-tinted night; magenta marks meaning, never decoration.
Geist Bold headlines at tight negative tracking; Geist Mono for script and output; JetBrains Mono uppercase labels for metadata.
Hairline rules instead of cards; flat, no shadows anywhere.
44px pills for actions; one authored SVG arrow is the only icon.
One authored motion moment (bars draw out, rows settle once); reduced motion shows everything at once.

rules.name: The Brand Repo Rule
rules.body: Colours are the synced --neoskript-* custom properties, aliased as --night, --raised, --rule, --text, --muted, --magenta, --string. Never type a new hex; resync from the brand repo.

rules.name: The sRGB Mix Rule
rules.body: Every translucent or derived colour is color-mix(in srgb, ...): Starlight's greys from text and night, the hover tints, the selection. oklch mixing drifts the hue.

rules.name: The Two Sides Rule
rules.body: On a staff, NeoSkript's side is magenta and Skript's is muted. Skript is never shown in magenta, and NeoSkript never in muted.

rules.name: The Label Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Uppercase JetBrains Mono labels name columns, servers, marks and licences. They never sit above a heading as an eyebrow.

rules.name: The Mono Means Code Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for script lines, server output, file names, hashes and commands. Words and numbers people read are Geist.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separation is a 1px night-rule line, never a box. Rows, sections, the download build block and the steps are ruled, not carded.

dos: Do take every colour, logo and scene from the brand repo (`pnpm brand:sync`), and use the aliased tokens.
Do separate with 1px `night-rule` hairlines and tone; keep everything flat.
Do put the same thing on both sides of a staff: Skript muted on the left, NeoSkript magenta on the right, one row per line, one scale for every bar.
Do carry the authored External arrow on every link to another site.
Do keep pills at 44px, one primary per action row.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: every animation and transition collapses to its end state, and nothing depends on an animation to become visible.

Do emit styles as files: authored code has no `<style>` inlined into the page and no `style` attributes (`inlineStylesheets: "never"`, no inlined assets), and scripts run only from files or hashed inline blocks, per the CSP in `public/_headers`.
donts: Don't use cards or card grids; facts, steps and rows are hairline rows.
Don't put an uppercase label above a heading as an eyebrow.
Don't use Unicode or emoji arrows or icons; the SVG arrow is the only icon.
Don't add shadows, glows or gradient text, or any atmosphere beyond the Xena horizon.
Don't use magenta decoratively, or Xena's Ion Blue anywhere.
